name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Campaigns | Email Programs, Action Pages & Plain-Language Writing
summary: Hands-on digital campaigns operator who writes, builds, sends, tests, and reports on email and SMS programs and conversion pages every week. Built a 20+ workflow automation system end to end at Solenzo (capture, segmentation, confirmations and reminders, onboarding nurture, reactivation), and writes the copy, landing pages, and newsletters that move busy small business owners to act. Fluent in CRM and email platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Marketo, Mailchimp), builds web pages directly in HTML/CSS, and works daily in agentic AI tools including Claude Code. Political Science minor who writes plainly for non-expert audiences and verifies before shipping.
